instruction: Launch vlc media player and begin playback of the Never Gonna Give You Up video file saved on the desktop.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.explanation: Variation emphasizing 'begin playback'. The evaluator confirms VLC is in playing state with the correct video file loaded.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) correctly extracts VLC playback state via HTTP interface and saves status.xml
Metric (is_vlc_playing) properly verifies both playing state AND correct filename match
Complete coverage: instruction requires playback of specific file, evaluator checks both state=='playing' and filename match
Expected filename 'Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4' matches the file downloaded in config
Robust implementation with multiple fallback methods for extracting file information from VLC XML (tries multiple XML paths)
Proper parameter handling: metric receives rules dict directly from get_rule and accesses rule['type'] and rule['file_name'] correctly
No postconfig needed: VLC HTTP interface remains accessible after playback starts
Edge cases handled: missing file info returns 0, multiple matching methods (basename, endswith, contains) increase robustness
